name: Shadowmaw Claw
summary: A Shadowmaw Claw comes from a panther in Stranglethorn Vale. Far Seer Mok'thardin needs these claws for an enchantment serving the Horde.

sections.title: Panther Claws
sections.body: Across the river from Mizjah Ruins, Shadowmaw Panthers and their elders hunt in the jungle. Far Seer Mok'thardin at Grom'gol Base Camp seeks their claws, along with a pristine tigress fang, for his enchantment. He believes the jungle's magic can be harnessed for the Horde.

faq.q: Where do Shadowmaw Claws come from?
faq.answer: Shadowmaw Panthers and Elder Shadowmaw Panthers in Stranglethorn Vale bear these claws.
Far Seer Mok'thardin at Grom'gol Base Camp seeks eight Shadowmaw Claws and a Pristine Tigress Fang.

faq.q: Why does Mok'thardin need the claws?
faq.answer: Mok'thardin needs Shadowmaw Claws and a Pristine Tigress Fang for an enchantment he means to make for the Horde.
Mok'thardin says Shadowmaw Panthers lurk across the river from Mizjah Ruins, to the southeast.

angles.text: Mok'thardin seeks these claws to harness the jungle's magic for a special enchantment in service of the Horde.
